note: Phase 1 seed record. The script measure_marginal_ablation.py appends one entry per CI run; the rolling baseline for regression is the most recent 'ok' record. When run on a host with no cached event scores (e.g. a fresh CI runner before measure_baseline has fit + cached), the record is written with status='needs_cache' so the ledger always carries a chronological account of suite reachability.
